༄༅/ /dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs shes rab mchog gi dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs shes rab mchog gi dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na ma swa ra swa sti ye/ 'dir dgra nag nas bshad pa'i dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i mngon rtogs bshad par bya ste/ de yang gnas yid du 'ong bar/ yo byad sogs 'du byas la/ skyabs sems sogs sngon tu btang nas/ tshogs zhing ni rang rje btsun dbyangs can mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram sogs rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun dbyangs can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha' auṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na maḥswa ra swa sti sa pā ri wā ra bh+yaḥ auṃ swa ra swa sti sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā'i bar gyis mchod la/ dkon mchog gsum la zhes sogs lan gsum dang*/ tshad med sngar ma byas na 'dir bsgom/ auṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ/ chos thams cad bdag med pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi sems nyid hrīṃ dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi ngo bo me long gsal zhing dwangs pa zhig tu gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo dbyangs can ma dmar mo byi ru'i mdog can/ lang tsho dar la bab cing sgeg pa'i nyams ldan/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gnyis rjes su chags pa'i tshul gyis gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che cung zad 'phyar ba'i tshul/ g.yon pas ye shes kyi le mong thugs kar bsnams shing*/ nu 'bur rab tu rgyas pa dbu skra nag snum phyed bcings pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs na nor bus mtshan zhing phyed sku stod du khebs pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/

zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sku rgyab brten pa 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor auṃ dkar po nas thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīṃ dmar po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i ye shes pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ auṃ swa ra swa sti ma hā ka ru ṇi ka e h+ye hi/ auṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsams la/ dbang bskur rgyas 'debs byed mi byed gnyis snang yang*/ byed na dbang lha spyan drangs nas dbang bskur ba dang*/ gshin rje gshed nag pos rgyas 'debs par bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /mchod pa ni/ auṃ swa ra swa sti ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ rab dmar byi ru'i mdangs ltar mdzes pa'i sku/ /rab gsal dri za'i dbyangs bzhin snyan pa'i gsung*/ /rab 'byams shes bya thogs med mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /rab mdzes lha mo dbyangs can ma la bstod/ /bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīṃḥyig gi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ las nyon gyi sgrib pa dang mi shes pa thams cad bsal/ slar yang sa bon las 'od zer 'phros skye 'phags thams cad kyi rnam dpyod spobs pa thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas hrīṃ yig la thim pas rang nyid blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas par gyur par bsams la/ auṃ swa ra swa sti hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥswāhā/ zhes ci 'grub bam/ 'bum phrag bdun nam/ bzhi dang gsum mam/ tha ma gcig bzla'o/ /mthar yig brgya bzla ba dang mchod bstod bya zhing*/ gtor ma 'bul na 'od zer gyis lha mo mdun gyi nam mkha' spyan drangs te/ auṃ swa ra swa sti a ka ro sogs kyis phul nas mchod bstod dang gsol gdab dang gshegs gsol dang bsngo smon bya'o/

/mtshan sngags la swa sti dang swa t+yai zhes pa gnyis ka 'byung bas 'gal ba mi snang zhing/ hrīṃḥyig gi mthar tsheg drag yod med gnyis las med pa mang ngo*/ /sbyin sreg gi dus su bstim nas dbang bskur rgyas 'debs byed mi byed skabs dang bstun/ de nas mchod 'bul sogs ni sbyin sreg nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /dmar mo'i sbyin sreg gi rdzas 'bul sogs kyi tshe mtshan sngags las gzhan dbyangs yig sbyar ram ma sbyar gnyis las ma sbyar kyang chog par sems so// //rgyal kun ye shes phung po gcig bsdus nas/ /rab mdzes lha mo'i gar gyi rnam rol te/ /don gnyer can la rnam dpyod mchog ster ba/ /rje btsun dbyangs can ma yis blo gros stsol/ /gang gis dad dung drod gsher gyis bskul bas/ /bdag blo ma la ya yi skyed tshal nas/ /sgrub thabs tsan dan ljon gsar zung 'khrungs 'dis/ /gzhan yid rmongs pa'i tsha gdung zhi gyur cig /rgyal sras mkhas mang rnams kyis nyer bsten pa'i/ /rgyal yum dbyangs can lha mos rjes bzung nas/ /rgyal kun dgongs pa rtogs dang lhan cig tu/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur du thob gyur cig /ces dbyangs can ma dkar dmar zung gi sby-in sreg mngon rtogs dang bcas pa 'di ni dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i la lung dge slong bsod nams dpal 'byor dang*/ yi ge 'dri 'don dang lha ris rtsis dkar nag sogs legs bshad du ma la sbyangs shing dad dang blo gros zung du 'brel ba'i bde thang ri rong tshul khrims rgya mtsho gnyis kyis 'di lta bu gyis dang khong rnam gnyis kyis par du bsgrub par bya'o nan tan tu bskul ba la brten nas shākya'i btsun pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa yang bskul pa po tshul khrims rgya mtsho ste/ dge bas tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun dbyangs can ma zung gis 'bral ba med par rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig

/ //mad+ga laṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs shes rab mchog gi dngos grub 'byung gnas bzhugs/ -PAGE 124--PAGE 125--PAGE 122-
